text:
Clara Jones: quick sync 1 Efficient Recs pilot handoff. We have a 6-week slot. Need a razor-thin MVP that customers can trial: batching recs, cache TTL guidance, a quantization checklist (doc-only), and eval-triggered alerts. What are must-ships vs nice-to-haves? cc @Owen Park @Rashmi Iyer

Owen Park: Must-haves: per-route batching suggestions (with expected cost % and p95 impact), KV-prefix TTL recs with hit-rate estimate, JSON export for config. Eval alerts = webhook -> Slack only for MVP. Defer auto-apply and auto-quant.

Rashmi Iyer: From CS: pilots want copy-paste snippets and a one-page "how to validate" checklist. Also want an "explain" line for each rec (1 sentence). Two pilots: HealthWorks (chat) and Batchify (long-gen). I'll reach out.

Liam O'Neal: Infra asks: telemetry window = 14 days, simulator required to estimate latency p95/p99 changes before surfacing recs. Canary support via traffic-tag (2-3%) and auto-revert if paired-eval drop >1% or p99 increases >25%. We should include p99 in outputs; tails matter.

Clara Jones: Acceptance criteria proposal: (1) recommender outputs ranked recs with confidence, cost%, p95/p99 estimate, and a one-line explain; (2) Exportable JSON + Node/Python SDK snippets; (3) Eval webhook that posts regression events to a Slack channel; (4) docs + 2 pilots onboarded with a validation checklist.

Owen Park: Implementation notes: recommender input = per-request token counts, latency, route tag, and payload variance. Output schema example: ```json
{"route":"/v1/generate","rec":"batching","confidence":0.79,"expected_cost":"-15%","p95_delta_ms":25,"p99_delta_ms":90,"explain":"low token variance, high request rate"}
``` Keep schema minimal.

Rashmi Iyer: Pilot plan: I'll send invites and prepare 3 eval sets (chat short, long-form, adversarial). Pilot acceptance: paired-eval delta <=1% absolute and p95 change <20% on canary.

Liam O'Neal: We'll add a simple cost model to convert token savings to $/month estimates using common cloud profiles. Export will include a dollar row. Also: simulator will run on sampled traces only for privacy.

Clara Jones: Cuts if needed: drop automated quant suggestions and any UI charts; ship table view + export only. Action items: @Owen build recommender POC + sample API by EOW, @Liam infra/simulator + cost model, @Rashmi pilot outreach + quickstart. card-bot will create tracking card.

card-bot: Created card OPT-8204 with subtasks: recommender-poc, simulator, sdk-exports, eval-webhook, pilot-runbook. Link: https://projects.internal/OPT-8204 :white_check_mark:

Rashmi Iyer: I'll prep the quickstart and two config snippets (chat + batch) and share by Tue. Example snippet: ```json
{"route":"/v1/chat","batching":{"enabled":true,"target_latency_ms":150},"cache":{"prefix":"session:","ttl_seconds":30}}
```

Owen Park: I'll post the short design doc with ranking formula (cost/latency/quality tradeoffs) and sample API response by Fri.

Clara Jones: Locking scope now: "suggest + export, eval webhook to Slack, docs + 2 pilots." Revisit auto-apply and quant automation next cycle. Thanks everyone :rocket:
